ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of the Feeding Our Future scheme, including how funds were allocated and spent.
questions: How were funds allocated in the Feeding Our Future scheme?
What were the financial consequences of the scheme?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a better understanding of the scope and impact of the scheme, and potentially identify other instances of fraud.
